note: Authored by reading Tafsir al-Tabari in English against the reader's modern translation. Each phrase carries the app's own words for that piece of the verse, a plain modern English line of my own, the Arabic of the piece, and the numbered paragraphs of the commentary that speak of it.

phrases.text: The help of God over the Quraysh, and the victory, which is the conquest of Mecca.

phrases.translation: and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺
phrases.text: The same thing, said another way: the victory that comes when God makes His Prophet victorious and helps him.

phrases.translation: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way
phrases.text: The tribes of the Arabs, the people of Yemen among them, and the tribes of Nizār, entering the religion of God in groups.
phrases.ar: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ

phrases.text: Throng after throng. The Prophet said this sign had been shown to him, and that he would say his praise and ask forgiveness when he saw it.

phrases.translation: then glorify the praises of your Lord
phrases.text: Glorify your Lord and magnify Him with thanks, for what He has fulfilled of His promise. For at that moment you draw near to Him, and you will taste what the messengers before you have tasted of death.
Ask Him to forgive your sins. The commentators understood the surah as a sign that the Prophet's death was near, and the Prophet said it plainly: as though he would be taken up in that year.

phrases.translation: for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance
phrases.text: He is the One who turns to His servant who has obeyed, toward what He loves. And this is a word about the end of the Prophet, for he lived only two years after it came down.
